item.title: github: Secret scanning adds detectors for Lovable, Supabase, and more
item.description:
GitHub Secret Scanning added new detectors for secrets from Lovable Labs, Pydantic Services Inc., and Supabase. A new provider also joined the secret scanning partnership program.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning coverage updates
item.description:
GitHub updated secret scanning coverage by adding more secrets to push protection, onboarding a new secret scanning partner, and including richer metadata in alerts. The post also notes the Secret Scanning Partnership Program now includes Lovable Labs.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Improvements to secret scanning and public monitoring
item.description:
GitHub rolled out updates to secret scanning and public monitoring. Resend is now a secret scanning partner, and secret scanning can detect new secret types from APIclub.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Manage secret scanning custom patterns via REST API
item.description:
GitHub now supports managing secret scanning custom patterns through the REST API. The new generally available endpoints let security teams list, create, and edit custom patterns programmatically.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Clearer names for secret scanning detector types
item.description:
GitHub is renaming secret scanning detector types to make it clearer how each detector finds secrets. This is a naming-only change.

  • Source: GitHub
